text.en:
The following subdivisions known as Severina Diamond, United Parañaque Phase 4, Supervill,
Irenville Subdivision, Irenville and Marcelo Green Village in Barangay La Huerta in the Municipality of
Parañaque, Metro Manila, is hereby detached and separated therefrom to form and constitute into a distinct
and independent barangay which created to be known as Barangay Marcelo Green without affecting in any
manner the legal existence of the mother barangay La Huerta.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
barangays, shall be applicable to barangay Marcelo Green.

The present elective barangay officials of Barangay La Huerta shall continue to perform their
duties as such officials in the newly created Barangay Marcelo Green until the barangay officials of said
barangay shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall hold office until their
successors shall have been elected in the regular elections for barangay officials following the issuance of this
Decree shall have qualified, unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Such appointive officers
and employees as may be necessary to organize or to complete the government personnel of the barangay
Marcelo Green shall be appointed as provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of Barangay Marcelo Green in the
obligations, funds, assets and other property of Barangay La Huerta shall be transferred by the President to the
newly created barangay upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive orders or regulations, inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-eight.
